_comment: Affected symbols for advisories whose OSV record names none. Keyed by advisory id; aliases match too. Each symbol is a dotted name as the code graph resolves it (module.Class, module.Class.method, module.function); a symbol also matches every dotted name below it. served_entry names the method a framework calls with each request when the symbol is an ASGI/WSGI application handed to a route table (Mount, app.mount). Hand-maintained: see docs/reference/dependency-proofs.md for how to add one.

GHSA-v5gw-mw7f-84px.note: StaticFiles.lookup_path checks containment with os.path.commonprefix, so a sibling directory whose name starts with the served directory's name passes; every request a mounted StaticFiles serves goes through it.
